sources.title: agent-squid agent/route_policy.py
sources.finding: Routes default off; bounded defaults include 16 turns, depth 4, 1800 total seconds, 300 seconds per turn, concurrency 4, topic 8 and global 32.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/continuations.py

sources.finding: Continuations persist successor sequences and bind execution to the original owner, scope and completion.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/instance_auth.py
sources.finding: Single-use pairing credentials expire after five minutes and paired device sessions after 30 days; host control uses a separate bearer secret.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/task_workspaces.py

sources.finding: Task workspaces use immutable repository/branch/worktree identity and a unique originating human request or watch issue key.

sources.locator: record_grant, scope_for, begin_review, finish_review and publication/reconciliation
sources.finding: Publication requires human grants, a review bound to exact head/tree, and durable intent before host-run Git/PR effects.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/worktree.py
sources.locator: ensure_worktree, setup/sync paths and dependency symlink helpers
sources.finding: Optional turn isolation materializes separate working directories, records sync outcomes and links configured dependency directories. This is code isolation, not an OS sandbox.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/topic_queue.py
sources.finding: Session turns queue per topic/agent, independent ad hoc turns start separately, and server workers own completion and sync.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/memory.py
sources.finding: Topic memory is a local Markdown document with YAML front matter, code-root scope and content-revision hashes.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/turn_context.py
sources.finding: Context references retain original-request and prior-result message IDs and record whether each source was injected or already in resumed history.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/watch_service.py
sources.finding: Watch observation and execution have separate enablement and credentials; dispatch belongs to the server.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/watch_policy.py
sources.finding: Watch policy bounds polling, lifetime, runs and attempts. Execution is off by default and topic policy can only narrow global policy.

sources.title: agent-squid agent/dependency_sync.py
